FortiADC-KVM # config load-balance pool
  edit "netops-173-pool-a"
    set type static
    set addr-type ipv4
    set health-check-ctrl disable
    set health-check-down-action reject
    unset health-check-list
    set real-server-ssl-profile NONE
    config  pool_member
      edit 1
        set health-check-inherit enable
        set status enable
        set real-server-ssl-profile-inherit enable
        set backup disable
        set pool_member_service_port 80
        set pool_member_weight 1
        set connection-limit 0
        set recover 0
        set warm-up 0
        set warm-rate 100
        set connection-rate-limit 0
        set pool_member_cookie rs1
        set real-server RS_A
        set mysql-read-only disable
--More--                  set mysql-group-id 0
        set proxy-protocol none
        set mssql-read-only disable
        set modify-host disable
        set auto-populate-from 0
      next
    end
  next
end

FortiADC-KVM #
